rules.intervals: temporal_label pairs with start != -1, end clipped to length, half-open [start, end)
rules.event: anchor nearest (start + end) / 2, earlier on ties
rules.negative: full window [a-150, a+150) inside [0, length) that overlaps no interval; max gap to the nearest interval, earlier on ties; else unavailable
rules.normal: anchor nearest length / 2, earlier on ties
rules.dedup: an input is (video_id, anchor); records sharing it are linked; each stratum counts it once
